integrity: Exact formulas proved symbolically; finite exhaustive and sampled cyclotomic checks are corroborative, not a substitute for the unrestricted proof.
scientific_limitations: Rank incidence and multiplicities only; no determinant conditioning, no minors of higher order. The basic unit-modulus rigidity lemma and depth-two classifications are prior results. Originality of the all-depth census is assessed from accessible literature, not independently certified.
title: Exact rank census and logarithmic rank-one incidence for three-by-three prime-power Fourier minors
